subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What provider-reported cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter responses, and which runtime/session surfaces should consume it?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the fix defines stable runtime/session semantics, provider-cost precedence, units, persistence, and channel rendering behavior that should not be chosen by automation alone.

options.title: Add Exact-Cost Metadata Contract
options.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, raw details, and fallback to existing local estimates where exact cost is unavailable.

options.title: Keep Exact Cost Outside Core
options.body: Leave core on estimated cost fields and route exact OpenRouter accounting to a plugin or external ledger surface until a broader observability design lands.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Usage Ledger
options.body: Defer this issue until the native per-call usage ledger and agent-facing usage API define the shared cost contract.

recommendation.title: Add Exact-Cost Metadata Contract
recommendation.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, raw details, and fallback to existing local estimates where exact cost is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history signal across usage cost reporting, session usage persistence, and prior review of this exact issue.
